description: CoolerControl is downloading; it waits for a restart once it is sealed.

extensions.name: CachyOS Proton
extensions.summary: Runs Windows games in Steam, with CachyOS's own fixes and tuning.
caveats: Pick another Proton for a single game in that game's Steam properties.

extensions.name: CoolerControl
extensions.summary: Fan curves and cooling for this PC, on a page of its own.
caveats: Fans go back to how they were whenever it stops.
Sign in to its page with your VaporOS password.

settings.label: Control the graphics card's fans
settings.help: Turns on AMD overdrive in the graphics driver.

settings.label: Sensor updates
settings.help: How often it reads temperatures and fan speeds.

confirm.title: Give the fans back to the hardware?
confirm.body: CoolerControl stops driving them until it starts again.

copy.install: CoolerControl runs as root to reach the fan and pump controllers.
copy.remove: Its service stops now, and the fans go back to how they were.

extensions.name: TruckersMP
extensions.summary: Multiplayer for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
caveats: Steam downloads ETS2 and ATS again as their Windows version. Profiles saved only on this PC stay with the Linux version.

confirm.title: Copy your Linux profiles?
confirm.body: Profiles saved only on this PC are copied to the Windows version. Profiles already there stay.

copy.install: Steam downloads ETS2 and ATS again as their Windows version. Profiles saved only on this PC stay with the Linux version.
copy.remove: ETS2 and ATS keep running with Proton. Switch them back in their Steam properties.

extensions.name: Star Citizen
extensions.summary: The RSI Launcher, set up to install Star Citizen on a game drive.
caveats: Easy Anti-Cheat isn't tested on VaporOS yet.
Needs a game drive with at least 150 GB free.

copy.remove: The game stays on its drive until you delete it there.
